outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Four original Switchback Pike battle animation paintings TWO columns TWO rows. Input is identity/costume/camera reference. Preserve bearded mountain guide, green feathered brim hat, green scarf, gray wool mantle with green edge, gray tunic/trousers, brown leather gloves and crampon boots, shoulder rope coil, backpack/bedroll/metal cup. One full-length rigid wooden pike with hooked steel spearhead and butt spike. Elevated three-quarter camera facing RIGHT, original painterly raster, same anatomy and body scale. TOP LEFT: full two-handed forward pike thrust RIGHT, front knee bends, torso leans forward, hands widely spaced on shaft; importantly long REAR shaft and butt spike remain visible extending LEFT behind rear hand, never end pole at palm. TOP RIGHT: withdraw pike to horizontal ready position, two elbows bent and two hands spaced; entire same-length shaft/head/butt visible. BOTTOM LEFT: softer upright defensive guard, diagonal pike across chest in BOTH hands, knees flexed, feet grounded, all backpack/rope retained. BOTTOM RIGHT: fully dead relaxed horizontal side body with HEAD RIGHT and boots LEFT, eyes closed mouth relaxed, cheek rests on loose forearm, hat/pack/bedroll retained. Complete pike lies horizontally beside hands, spearhead RIGHT, butt spike LEFT, not piercing body. Entire head-to-butt weapon fits in each cell with ample gutters/margins. No shield, extra limb, missing pack/rope, exaggerated weapon size, text, grid, effects, blood or shadows. Flat pure BLUE #0000FF backdrop for approved extraction, no blue spill, no copied game art.

Source scales 0.58/0.44 remain uniform per source. The thrust ground anchor is 350,471 so its full forward pike fits the 512-wide frame without clipping or shrinking the body. Banded crops exclude neighboring guard-tip, boot and fallen-pike fragments. Old/new and within-source weapon lengths still vary; walking leg support/hand grip, pike/body/palette/edge consistency and connected action/death timing need refinement.
